[LFST.6.3.2] An outbound call is recorded as a `CallIssued` atom ([RFCS.15]),
and the engine emits one for every call it issues ([RFCS.15.6]). As an
engine-initiated action it is **compare** class: re-derived and byte-compared
on replay, never delivered to the engine as an input ([RFCS.3.4]). Recorded
provenance for the other verbs is deferred ([RFCS.15.7]).
